data_provenance.scope: Pinned substitute byte corpus, not the checkpoint's original validation split

calibration.scope: Bounded local-output measurements on supplied inputs only; fused projections are isolated and cross-layer/final-task effects are not bounded

metrics.scope: End-to-end gates only for supplied inputs and optional position sampling; passing is not a universal accuracy or downstream-task guarantee

memory.scope: Persistent bytes are tensor-inventory accounting, not RSS. Cache assumes every selected VQ projection is populated. Memory mode estimates one streaming row block or active-expert decode group; speed mode estimates full decoded banks. Values use source-dtype bytes and exclude padded float32 intermediates, activations, and KV cache.

calibration.scope: Bounded local-output measurements on supplied inputs only; fused projections are isolated and cross-layer/final-task effects are not bounded

metrics.scope: End-to-end gates only for supplied inputs and optional position sampling; passing is not a universal accuracy or downstream-task guarantee

quality.scope: Additive squared local errors guide selection only. They are not an end-to-end NLL, KL, task-accuracy, or cross-layer interaction bound.

plan.scope: Persistent tensor-byte accounting is exact for the represented dense state and selected payloads. Decode bytes are estimates; local errors are not end-to-end accuracy guarantees.

report.scope: Per-tensor weight measurements only; excludes tokenizer, KV cache, activations, runtime overhead, and model-quality guarantees

model_provenance.training: mixed corpus, checkpoint step 19999; real trained weights

runtime_comparison.conclusion: Persistent tensor storage is smaller. On this tiny model, sampled process RSS does not establish a RAM saving because runtime/library overhead dominates. Streaming trades latency for zero retained decoded cache; speed mode restores latency by retaining full decoded weights. These are not throughput claims.

runtime_workers.scope: Fresh CPython process; sampled phase RSS plus ru_maxrss. Four greedy tokens recompute the context without KV caching. Not a throughput benchmark.
